name: cycle2-robust-confirmation-20260930
purpose: Explicitly authorized, fixed four-origin independent confirmation of the existing single-importance frequency-aligned robust incumbent with final-clipping-matched robust raw/native references. Not bagged, not plan-gated, not a new algorithm search.

lineage.scope: No source, target, predictor, rights, provider-policy or candidate-cohort substitution.

preregistration.expected_cells_formula: 4 unchanged families * 3 IID folds * 4 methods * 4 learners * seed2028
preregistration.metadata_eligibility: The prior reserved pool required reported class minimum>=60; this metadata recheck retains that criterion. Actual post-release payload/generated-split admission still enforces the unchanged30/20/10 runtime margins.

method_semantics_documentation_only.interpretation: Documentation only, not a method-overrides runtime schema. Exact registered method names and frozen source/config/manifest identities bind the actual implementations.

all_final_learners.policy: Same training-support NumericQuantileClipper for all four method final learner pipelines. Numeric bounds are fitted on the current training partition only, before downstream imputation/scaling/native handling; no held-out quantiles.

baseline-robust.description: Reviewed raw predictors with the same final training-support clipping as all three engineered methods.

featcopilot-frequency-aligned-robust.aligned_search: Existing aligned path evaluates FE+learner pipelines for each of the same three settings, and refits selected features using the chosen training-only setting. Not a permanently middle-setting selector.

openfe-inductive-native-robust.generation: Identical existing first-order full numeric/categorical candidate generation, training-only inductive DAG transforms and native selected width. Existing training-median generation preparation; original numeric missingness restored afterward.
openfe-inductive-native-robust.not_claimed: No clipping retrofit into OpenFE internal ranking, no stock transductive transform, no new operator filtering.

autofeat-native-robust.generation: Identical existing native generation/selection and train-fitted one-hot adapter; original numeric missingness restored before the matched final learner.

method_semantics_documentation_only.catboost_representation_caveat: The existing candidate-selection CatBoost estimator drops cat_features and is evaluated through numeric candidate-engine preprocessing. Final CatBoost retains native categorical handling with the shared final clipper. This known mismatch is disclosed; no runtime rewrite or categorical conversion experiment.
method_semantics_documentation_only.failure_policy: No native-reference error-to-baseline substitution, narrowing of feature output, retries with easier algorithms, or outcome-based dataset replacement.

decision_and_reporting_plan.family_loss: Arithmetic mean primary loss over ALL three preregistered splits for each family/method/learner; any missing/nonfinite split makes that paired family-method loss incomplete.
decision_and_reporting_plan.aggregation: Equal-family mean/median relative gains per classification/regression x learner stratum; report family raw losses separately. Do not pool unscaled losses across tasks.
decision_and_reporting_plan.positive_vs_raw: Strictly positive mean G versus baseline-robust in EACH of eight task/learner strata.
decision_and_reporting_plan.family_harm: No family/learner loss worsening above5% relative to baseline-robust.
decision_and_reporting_plan.reference_gate: Mean G >=0 against EACH of the two complete paired robust native references in EACH task/learner stratum; no selecting the easier reference after results.
decision_and_reporting_plan.failure_gate: Failures, RSS kills, timeouts, incomplete pairs, unsupported tasks, budget skips and missing/nonfinite losses block broad claims. Report all planned denominators; no successful-case-only promotion.
decision_and_reporting_plan.zero_denominator: No artificial epsilon or family deletion. Zero/nonfinite reference losses make the relative gate indeterminate; report absolute losses and block automatic passage.
decision_and_reporting_plan.win_tie_loss: Per family/learner/reference: win if G>1%, loss if G<-1%, tie otherwise.

intervals.method: Descriptive paired family-block percentile intervals, seed2028,10000 resamples,95% level.
intervals.limits: Only three classification families and one regression family. No between-family regression confidence interval can be estimated from one family; do not bootstrap folds as independent families or claim significance.

decision_and_reporting_plan.scope: Four predetermined observational source families, including ONE regression origin. This can only test a narrowly defined held-out cohort; it cannot establish broad SOTA, general regression superiority, cross-modality leadership or default promotion.
decision_and_reporting_plan.resources: Report expected/successful/failed cells and complete paired families per method/task/learner, elapsed active time, per-cell timing, peak RSS and remaining budget.

preregistration.source_split_policy: Source policies remain iid for two UCI recipes and official for two OpenML recipes. Full source dimensions/IDs/hashes are validated/preserved, but explicit whole-cohort IID3 is the evaluation policy; no official-fold reproduction claim.
preregistration.method_selection_basis: The user selected one existing uniform incumbent using prior exposed-development work. No reserved-family outcomes, success rates, labels or payloads are used for candidate/task/learner selection.

budget_context.policy: The12h hard ceiling is not a completion guarantee. Jobs remain interleaved; unfinished/budget-skipped cells stay in coverage and claim accounting.

Lifetime People who have liked your Page and engaged with your post
datasets.prediction_time: Recorded cumulative total interactions for the supplied Facebook posts, using only the seven variables documented as available before publication. Retrospective post-level response regression, not a fixed-horizon engagement forecast.

iid_suitability_review.observation_unit_basis: Primary metadata identifies rows as distinct posts from one known cosmetics page during2014. IID here is explicitly within that fixed page/year post-record population, conditional on the supplied calendar attributes; not independent brands, unseen pages or forward-time generalization.
iid_suitability_review.target_timing: All eleven other post-impact/engagement columns are excluded, including comment/like/share components of the target. No precise cumulative-observation horizon is invented.
iid_suitability_review.not_claimed: Unseen subjects/entities beyond the declared row unit, future-period transfer, causal effects or individual deployment.
